title: Merging two contacts that both have a Storage folder
text: Two contacts who each already have their own Storage folder can now be merged. The merge window shows a new Storage step that says exactly what will happen: which files move into the kept person's folder, which folders are joined because they have the same name, and which files are renamed because the name was already taken. Nothing is overwritten and nothing is deleted. If both folders hold a file with the same name, both are kept and the incoming one gets a number, for example Passport (2).jpeg, so you can look at both and delete the extra afterwards. A merge is still refused, with the reason written out, when the person being merged away has files in the trash. Restore them first.
points: Open a contact, press Delete / Merge, pick the other contact
Read the new Storage step: what moves, what is joined, what is renamed
Type MERGE. Both Storage folders become one, under the kept contact
